## Scope

- [ ] Product/UI change
- [ ] API or data model change
- [ ] Supabase SQL/storage change
- [ ] Backup/restore or deployment change
- [ ] Documentation-only change

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Production smoke check, if deployed

## Privacy And Safety

- [ ] No `.env.local`, Supabase secret, access code, calendar token, or private family contact detail is included
- [ ] Private API changes preserve family/child ownership checks
- [ ] Tutor-facing changes do not expose parent dashboard data
- [ ] Storage changes keep files private by default
